cohort: 36 HIV-positive pregnant women, between 2012-2014, at age of 25-32 years old
finding: Newborns of HIV-positive pregnant women, or those with advanced disease (AIDS), had lower birth weight and APGAR scores.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was established as the birth method in all HIV-positive pregnant women after 38 weeks of amenorrhea, on intact membranes, outside labor, resulting in halving the percentage of HIV-positive children.
